tasks.subject: Custom Output Style
tasks.description: Create custom output styles for the agent which change the tone and verbiage it choses its responses with. These could be playful (noir, cowboy) or practical (caveman, researcher).

tasks.subject: Fix jj footer to report ?? on error
tasks.description:
The getVcsInfo() function in extensions/improved-footer/index.ts can surface errors or crash when jj fails (e.g. stale workspace, corrupt .jj dir, jj not on PATH). The exec() helper swallows its own errors but the surrounding code is not fully guarded.

Files: extensions/improved-footer/index.ts

Acceptance criteria:
- Any failure in getVcsInfo() (exec error, thrown exception, bad output) returns "jj:??" rather than crashing or showing garbage
- A stale workspace (jj fails with a workspace error) shows "jj:???" in the footer
- The fix wraps the entire getVcsInfo call site (or the function body) in a broad try/catch so no exception can bubble up into the footer render path

tasks.subject: Fix `navigateTo()` O(distance) synthetic key events
tasks.description:
**File:** `editor.ts:278-304`

Every cursor jump (`w`, `b`, `e`, `gg`, `ge`, `gw` label jumps, `n`/`N` search navigation) emits O(|lineDelta| + targetCol) individual `super.handleInput()` calls. Jumping from line 20, col 60 back to line 0, col 0 emits ~100 synthetic key events.

**Fix:** Lobby for or shim a `setCursor()` API on `CustomEditor` to replace the synthetic-keypress loop.

**Plan file:** plans/helix-perf-01-navigate-to.md

tasks.subject: Hoist `Intl.Segmenter` to module scope in `wordWrapLine()`
tasks.description:
**File:** `buffer.ts:155-156`

`Intl.Segmenter` is instantiated on every `wordWrapLine()` call. For a 15-line buffer, each render in select mode creates 15 instances. It's stateless/reusable — hoist to module scope.

**Fix:** One-line change — move `new Intl.Segmenter()` to module level.

**Plan file:** plans/helix-perf-02-intl-segmenter.md

tasks.subject: Cache word-wrap results in `computeSelectionSpans()`
tasks.description:
**File:** `label-overlay.ts:175-222`

`computeSelectionSpans()` recomputes word-wrap for ALL lines even when selection covers only one line. Duplicates work already done by `super.render(width)`. No caching or sharing of layout results.

**Fix:** Cache word-wrap results per-render (keyed on text + width), or compute a cumulative visual-row index once and reuse across `computeSelectionSpans` and `buildLabelMap`.

**Plan file:** plans/helix-perf-03-duplicated-word-wrap.md

tasks.subject: Cache search matches in `navigateMatch()` instead of rescanning
tasks.description:
**File:** `editor.ts:369-399`

`navigateMatch()` rescans entire text on every `n`/`N` press. In Normal/Select mode no edits occur between navigation presses, so a dirty flag or text-identity check would avoid redundant full-text regex scans.

**Fix:** Cache matches and invalidate only when `getText()` identity/length changes.

**Plan file:** plans/helix-perf-04-navigate-match-rescan.md

tasks.subject: Eliminate per-character object allocation in `tokenize()`
tasks.description:
**File:** `label-overlay.ts:108-125`

For an 80-char line, `tokenize()` creates ~80 heap-allocated `{type, raw}` objects. In select mode, this runs for every rendered line with a selection span, on every render frame.

**Fix:** A single-pass highlight that walks the string and emits directly to an output buffer (no intermediate token array) would eliminate this allocation.

**Plan file:** plans/helix-perf-05-tokenize-per-char.md

tasks.subject: Optimize `offsetToLineCol()` with line-length prefix sum
tasks.description:
**File:** `buffer.ts:27-38`

`offsetToLineCol()` is O(n) linear scan called multiple times per operation. When `getLines()` is already available, a simple prefix-sum over line lengths would be O(1) per lookup.

**Fix:** Add an `offsetToLineColFromLines(lines, offset)` that walks by line lengths instead of character-by-character.

**Plan file:** plans/helix-perf-06-offset-to-linecol.md

tasks.subject: Simplify `selectionStart()`/`selectionEnd()` to avoid offset conversion
tasks.description:
**File:** `selection.ts:70-90`

These functions call `lineColToOffset` twice to determine which endpoint is "earlier", but a simple tuple comparison `(line, col)` suffices — no offset computation needed.

**Plan file:** plans/helix-perf-07-selection-offset-conversion.md

tasks.subject: Unify repeated `normalizeRange` computation in selection helpers
tasks.description:
**File:** `selection.ts`

`isNonEmpty`, `selectionCharCount`, `selectionLineRange`, and `selectionText` all independently call `normalizeRange`. When used together the offset computation is redundantly repeated.

**Fix:** Compute range once and pass it through, or unify into a single `getSelectionInfo()` that returns all needed data.

**Plan file:** plans/helix-perf-08-repeated-normalize-range.md

tasks.subject: Remove dead code: `findWordStarts()` and `findWordEnds()`
tasks.description:
**File:** `buffer.ts:51-73`

These functions scan the entire text and return all positions. They are never called anywhere in the extension — actual navigation uses the incremental `nextWordStart()`, `prevWordStart()`, `nextWordEnd()` variants. Remove entirely.

**Plan file:** plans/helix-perf-09-dead-code.md

tasks.subject: DRY duplicated ANSI regex in label-overlay
tasks.description:
**File:** `label-overlay.ts:40` vs `label-overlay.ts:98`

`stripAnsi()` uses an inline regex literal that must "stay in sync" with `ANSI_RE` defined 60 lines below. Violates DRY and creates a latent bug vector.

**Fix:** Extract to a shared constant or have `stripAnsi()` reference `ANSI_RE`.

**Plan file:** plans/helix-perf-10-duplicated-ansi-regex.md

tasks.subject: Replace spread-into-Math with simple loop in `applySelectionHighlight`
tasks.description:
**File:** `label-overlay.ts:246-247`

`Math.min(...rowSpans.map(...))` creates two intermediate arrays and spreads them into function arguments. Replace with a simple loop.

**Plan file:** plans/helix-perf-11-spread-into-math.md

tasks.subject: Extract shared `resetPendingState()` for mode transitions
tasks.description:
**File:** `editor.ts:93-118`

All three mode-transition methods (`enterInsert`, `enterNormal`, `enterSelect`) reset overlapping subsets of state (`pendingPrefix`, `pendingReplace`, `labelMode`, `labelMap`).

**Fix:** Extract a shared `resetPendingState()` helper to eliminate repetition and reduce risk of forgetting to clear a field when adding new pending states.

**Plan file:** plans/helix-perf-12-state-reset-duplication.md

tasks.subject: Replace fragile 30% heuristic in `getMaxVisibleLines()`
tasks.description:
**File:** `editor.ts:354-358`

`getMaxVisibleLines()` guesses at the editor's visible height using `Math.floor(rows * 0.3)`. If the editor exposes its actual content height, using the real value would be more robust.

**Plan file:** plans/helix-perf-13-max-visible-lines-heuristic.md
